_comment: Animation takes for the anime cast (Tools/dai/anime). Idle, Walk and Run are solved procedurally on the cast skeleton by Tools/dai/anime/gait.py (biomechanical foot planting, see build.py); the other states are CC0 Quaternius takes retargeted onto the shared anime skeleton. 'take' = source action name (after the last '|'); optional 'frames' [first, last], 'speed' (playback multiplier) and 'arm_drop' (degrees: the astronaut's bulky suit holds the arms away from the body). 'anime_models': existing anime base models (VRM / glTF / FBX humanoids) the cast is built from (Tools/dai/anime/models.py); drop your own in Tools/thirdparty/<pack>/<asset>/ with a SOURCE.txt and register them here.
